title: Affine compact-support representatives
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime ell and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. All schemes are separated finite-type k-schemes in u. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with a certificate IsEllAdicCoefficient ell Lambda, allowing continuous finite extensions, integral valuation rings with torsion, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Write B_T for the full bounded constructible subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of internal Lambda_T-module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let f:U -> Y with U affine, c a compactification of f and K in B_Y. There exist L in B_U and epsilon:Rf!_c L -> K such that a |-> Rf!_c(a);epsilon is a bijection Hom(M,L) -> Hom(Rf!_c M,K) for every M in B_U. This represents the Hom functor only on bounded constructible tests; it does not choose a localizing right adjoint.

source.place: Part (2), affine closed factorization in sk-thm-restriction-local.proof.md and sk-thm-int-restriction-glue.proof.md (2); Lean split: lean/Sheaf/AlgebraicGeometry/EllAdicAffineCompactSupportRepresentable.lean (affine_compactSupport_representable)

proof.text: Choose finitely many generators of the affine k-algebra of U. The same coordinates over Y give i:U -> A^n_Y. Its composite with the separated base-change A^n_Y -> A^n_k is the closed embedding over k; hence i is closed and f=i;p.
Use affine projection duality to obtain P on A^n_Y and natural Hom equivalences for every closed support, independent of U and c.

Apply closed-support representability to i and P, giving L and eta:i_*L -> P. Transport eta through the inverse Hom equivalence to epsilon:Rf!L -> K. Naturality identifies postcomposition with epsilon with the closed-support postcomposition followed by the inverse equivalence, so it is bijective.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_compactSupport_representable
    {U : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom] [IsSeparated U.hom]
    [IsAffine U.left] (f : U ⟶ Y) (c : Compactification f.left)
    (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) :
    ∃ L : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ U.left)).FullSubcategory,
      ∃ ε : (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).obj L.obj ⟶ K.obj,
        ∀ M : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ U.left)).FullSubcategory,
          Function.Bijective (fun a : M.obj ⟶ L.obj ↦
            (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).map a ≫ ε)
